items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: When did Sweets Edison join the band? It must have been in New York.

ctx.x: Right, right, fine, and this is how Basie got his start, you know, with the Moten band. You see, at this time all these fellows were not with Basie; Booker Walder and Woody and Mack Washington. They had all left the band.
When did Sweets Edison join the band? It must have been in New York.
